home.heroSubtitle: Describe the trip you want. JourneyMesh picks the right specialists, checks the numbers and hands you a plan you can change.
home.step1Body: Free text, structured fields, or both. Nothing is sent to a model before the guardrails clear it.
home.step2Body: A weather question runs one agent. A full journey runs five. Nothing runs that is not needed.
home.step3Title: You review before anything is final
home.step3Body: Approve the draft, or say what to change. Only the affected parts are planned again.

about.title: About JourneyMesh
about.intro: JourneyMesh is an agentic travel planner: a supervisor decides which specialists a request needs, each specialist works on its own slice of a shared state, and every external call passes an authorisation guard before it leaves the system.
about.architectureBody: A React interface talks to a FastAPI service. Requests pass input guardrails, then a LangGraph workflow runs the supervisor and the specialist agents. Results are checked, scored and paused for your review before anything is treated as final.

agents.supervisor: Supervisor - decides which agents a request needs.
agents.flight: Flight agent - resolves airports and researches routes.
agents.hotel: Hotel agent - shortlists stays against budget and party size.
agents.weather: Weather agent - retrieves conditions and packing advice.
agents.budget: Budget agent - separates confirmed prices from estimates.
agents.itinerary: Itinerary agent - builds a realistic day-by-day plan.
agents.final: Final response agent - assembles the approved journey in your language.

about.safetyBody: Prices are labelled with where they came from. Estimates are never presented as live prices. Personal documents are redacted before anything leaves the service, and requests that try to change the system's instructions are refused.
about.languagesBody: The interface and the generated journey are available in English, Bengali and Hindi. Your choice is remembered in this browser.
